verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA B200 is GPU and DGX server hardware. Issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials for an agent is a SaaS/API-platform axis, so this story is a category error for this kind of product. The pack mentions BMC management interfaces (Redfish/IPMI) and an absent OpenAPI spec, but nothing shows the product issuing scoped agent credentials, so nothing flips the axis to applicable.
